catalog.title: Merge completed fitting shards
catalog.mac: Research methods: Author request, review inputs, then open execution and evidence. Both CLIs use science interview/draft/publish and the same managed engine.
outputs: Merge raw float32 sums in deterministic global-row order, weighted by fitted rows, with overlap detection and recorded source lineage.
catalog.restriction: Uses reviewed inputs and immutable scientific outputs. No environment installation, automatic retries, or scientific qualification.

actions.authorityReason: Inspect staged scientific inputs and execution resources without execution or authorship.
Execute a reviewed scientific operation and retain its scientific output type.

access.restriction: Calls the existing route with its existing service role and scientific gates. Request path parameters, query and body remain explicit; this adapter does not change execution topology or retry mutations.

interview.title: Merge completed fitting shards
interview.purpose: Merge raw float32 sums in deterministic global-row order, weighted by fitted rows, with overlap detection and recorded source lineage.

fields.label: Completed fitting runs
fields.help: One workspace-relative run directory per line. Include only the latest completed continuation of each shard; overlapping contributions are rejected.

fields.label: Allow and label incomplete coverage
fields.help: A partial merge records exactly which planned rows are missing. It does not silently pretend all shards finished.

fields.label: Intended use
fields.help: testing or evidence. Qualification and held-out assessment remain separate.

interview.claimBoundary: Coverage and readout stability must be interpreted for the selected corpus and runtime. Outputs do not establish behavioral validity.
questions: Which corpus range and resource budget answer the research question?
